title: nRF54L15-DK ENC28J60 Ethernet controller (SPIM22) via the Contiki-NG SPI HAL

test.description: examples/platform-specific/nrf/enc28j60-test (Contiki-NG feature/nrf-spi-driver) probes an ENC28J60 on SPIM22 through arch/dev/ethernet/enc28j60/enc28j60-arch-spi-hal.c: soft reset, ESTAT.CLKRDY after the oscillator start-up, EREVID, a scratch register round-trip, and a six-register MAC address round-trip that needs the dummy byte MAC reads return. It then runs enc28j60_init() and polls for frames. The expected lines are the real PCA10156's serial output from 2026-09-06. With no frame path yet, 'alive: 0 frames' is the correct steady state.

steps.wait: polling for frames -- plug the module into a switch
alive: 0 frames so far (no cable, or nothing on the link yet)
